broker.name: Equiti
broker.tagline: Its site names 7 regulators, including FSA (Seychelles), FCA, and JSC. Rules depend on where you live. Advertised leverage: Up to 1:2000.
broker.about: The Equiti pages checked on 11 October 2026 do not state a founding year or one headquarters. Account names on its site include Seychelles tier, name not shown in the page extract, Seychelles tier, name not shown in the page extract, Seychelles tier, name not shown in the page extract, and Micro. Platforms named there include MT4, MT5, MQ WebTrader, and Equiti Trader. The site names these regulators: FSA (Seychelles), FCA, JSC, SCA, CMA (Kenya), CBA, and CySEC. The company on an account depends on where the client lives. Minimum deposit is not a single number on the pages that loaded. The highest leverage figure taken from those pages is Up to 1:2000. Leverage increases losses as well as gains.
broker.regulators_note: The company behind an account depends on where you live. FSA (Seychelles): Equiti Brokerage (Seychelles) Limited. FCA: Equiti Capital UK Ltd, 528328. JSC: Equiti Group Limited Jordan, 50248. SCA: Equiti Securities Brokers Currencies LLC. CMA (Kenya): EGM Securities / FXPesa. CBA: Equiti AM. CySEC: Equiti Global Markets. Company registration named on the site: 2020 Equiti press release: Equiti Capital UK Ltd, company no. 07216039, FCA FRN 528328. Seychelles, Jordan, UAE, Kenya, Armenia and Cyprus registration numbers were not on the pages fetched, except Jordan licence 50248..

broker.leverage_note: Leverage increases losses as well as gains, and you can lose more than you deposit. The highest figure on this card is the highest number this broker advertises. It is not the cap on every account. The cap depends on the company, the product and where you live.

_notes.fetch_notes: Homepage, Seychelles about, Seychelles accounts, Seychelles FAQ, Jordan about and a 2020 Equiti Capital press release fetched on 2026-10-11. The Seychelles about timeline lists events without years, so founded is null. The accounts page extract listed conditions but not the names of the three main tiers, so those names were left blank rather than guessed. FCA 528328 is from the 20 April 2020 press release still on equiti.com. Jordan licence 50248 is on the Jordan about page. Other licence numbers were not on the fetched pages. Direct HTML download of the accounts URL was only a short script shell; the readable text came from WebFetch.
